location: Arlequino and Rena's room, Eurazania capital

facts.arlequino_statement: Never remind me of my past again. My past, present and future are Rena and our little prince, perhaps more princes and princesses.
facts.meaning: Arlequino explicitly frames Rena and their future family as his chosen past/present/future and rejects returning emotionally to his former life.
facts.privacy: This is intimate relationship memory, not public knowledge.
